fields.summary: KS-04 Chat/DCS single consumption path implemented. Renderer refs are typed retrieval intent only; Main no longer calls wiki.get or splices knowledge bodies into chat.send; Gateway resolves through memory-wiki / Role Memory / SEKB source adapters and injects admitted refs as dcs-knowledge ContextCandidates; denied refs return visible reasons.

KS-05 experience closed loop: failure task -> redacted trajectory -> deterministic gate -> Inbox candidate -> duplicate/conflict detection -> human confirm/reject -> next fresh session recalls Principle via KS-04 single path -> cited/adopted/outcome -> effectiveness update -> delete/revoke prevents recall.

Unified knowledge system lifecycle: KS-00..KS-04 implemented and package-gated. KS-04 awaits user confirmation before Task Forest apply. Next serial node after confirmation is KS-05 (TF-0076). Product locks remain false.

rationale: KS-04 Chat/DCS single consumption path implemented and package-level gates passed (spec validate without --no-diff, root/runtime focused tests, test:dcs, typecheck, contract, db check, builds, comms replay/compare, changed-file ESLint). Main no longer pre-reads wiki.get or splices refs into the prompt; Gateway resolves typed refs through owner source adapters and injects admitted refs through the dcs-knowledge ContextCandidate path. Denied refs return visible reasons. TF-0075 closes done(100%); TF-0076 becomes the single ready next node and must wait for user confirmation of KS-04 before starting.
